subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Should maintainers require live or focused Discord integration proof before sponsoring a fix for this add-channel-while-running report?
rationale: Source shows both an intended generic restart path and a plausible stale startup allowlist if that path is missed, so automation cannot safely pick the repair location without proof of the current-main failure point.

options.title: Require Discord reload proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a live Discord run, redacted logs, or a focused integration harness showing that a newly added guild channel is still dropped on current main before repair begins.

options.title: Sponsor a source-level repair now
options.body: Accept the reporter's 2026.6.1 reproduction as sufficient and have an owner inspect the config watcher, reload planner, and Discord provider restart path for a targeted fix.

options.title: Fold into broader reload design
options.body: Defer this to the account-scoped/dynamic allowlist reload work, accepting that the Discord-specific message-loss symptom remains unresolved until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Require Discord reload proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a live Discord run, redacted logs, or a focused integration harness showing that a newly added guild channel is still dropped on current main before repair begins.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof decision is most tied to Discord provider/allowlist behavior and safe authorization semantics, where the history points most strongly to steipete.
